chronology.text: Kalinga Weaves Cooperative is the registered owner of the Binakul Series, a collection of fourteen textile designs registered with the Intellectual Property Office on 9 November 2023 under Certificate No. A2023-4471.

On 18 June 2026, 118 listings offering products bearing the registered designs were captured from the online store of Trend Republic Manila Trading Corp. The captures were made by an IT specialist who executed an affidavit on the manner of capture.

On 30 June 2026, plaintiff demanded that respondent delist the products and render an accounting. On 4 July 2026, respondent denied copying, attributed the fabric to a third party supplier, and delisted without admitting liability.

contradictions.claim: Respondent denies copying and points to a third party supplier.
contradictions.against: The store listings use the phrase Binakul Print in fourteen product titles that match the registered pattern names.
contradictions.observation: A supplier defence does not sit easily with product titles that name the registered series. Worth pinning down in the request for admission.
